snippet.title: Glowing Lamps - Story Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Look for the game now on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/3652160/Glowing_Lamps/

In a bleak city of an alternate post-Soviet 90s, where panel blocks meet high-tech energy, you play as a KGB-trained Soviet engineer with sharp mind and blunt force.

Trying to unleash a world-changing technology for humanity, you get involved in a dangerous conspiracy where oligarchs, foreign spies, and corrupt militia clash.

Approach every mission your way: use blunt force, strike from the shadows, master the environment, and make choices that directly shape your journey toward multiple distinct endings.
